title: Backpropagation through space, time and the brain
core_idea: Introduce generalized latent equilibrium (GLE), an energy-based, neuron-local framework that formulates neuronal dynamics via stationarity from neuron-local mismatches and parameter dynamics as gradient descent to enable fully local spatio-temporal credit assignment in physical, dynamical neuronal networks.
tldr: Proposes GLE, a neuron-local energy-based framework that aims to realize fully local spatio-temporal credit assignment in continuous-time neuronal networks by leveraging dendritic morphology and prospective coding to approximate backward and forward propagation through space and time.
